name: @pipeworx/mcp-maven-central

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across Maven Central packages by groupId, artifactId, version, or tags. Returns artifact coordinates, latest version, and download timestamps for up to 200 matches.

tools.name: search_by_coords
tools.description: Structured lookup by Maven coordinates. Provide any combination of groupId / artifactId / version.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List all published versions of a Maven artifact identified by groupId and artifactId, with release timestamps, using the Maven Central Solr GAV core.

tools.name: latest_version
tools.description: Most recent release version of (groupId, artifactId).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-maven-central forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the maven-central pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
